name: Nanamika
source: She is a half-human, half-elf woman. She works at the facility as an instructor. She hopes that humans and half-elf can coexist without discrimination. She is kind, calm, and popular among trainees. She is a graduate of the facility and a former adventurer, so she is well known for her abilities.
